general.name: End of Service Gratuity (accrual)
general.description: End-of-service benefit for expatriate employees under the UAE Labour Law: 21 days' basic wage per year of service for the first five years, 30 days' basic wage per year thereafter, capped at two years' total pay. Shown here as a monthly employer provision, not an employee deduction.

eligibility.notes: Expatriate employees who have completed at least one year of continuous service. Nationals are covered by GPSSA instead. Gratuity is paid on termination; the monthly figure here is an accrual/provision for the employer.

calculationRules.name: Monthly gratuity accrual
calculationRules.description: First five years: 21 days' basic wage per year -> about 5.83% of basic wage per month. From year six: 30 days per year -> about 8.33%. Only the basic wage counts (allowances excluded).

reporting.dueDate: Within 14 days of the last working day

validations.name: Expatriates only
validations.errorMessage: End-of-service gratuity applies to expatriate employees; nationals are covered by GPSSA
